account: It is day 0, shortly after 09:00. I came from home to town hall and read the appointment book. Today calls for office correspondence at 08:00, a plaza market walk at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a mill grain inspection at 10:00. I returned the book to the appointments chest at 08:57. The secretary has just said the chest is empty and asked whether I have the book; that may reflect looking while I had it out, rather than anything suspicious. I should clarify that I returned it. I asked about correspondence, town news, and which cottage hosts tea, but have not yet received answers. Several townsfolk have passed near the hall; I have seen no unusual activity or heard news establishing any hidden undertaking. My feeling that something is happening without me remains only a suspicion, with no identified participants or purpose.
